notes: The refuter's overturn reproduces. RECORD VARYING 1 TO 15 DEPENDING ON LEN; the first 01 holds 'E PIC X OCCURS 1 TO 15 DEPENDING ON CNT', the second is PIC X(15). The program writes a 12-character record, sets CNT to 2 and does READ ... INTO W. LEN is 12, so arm a) makes 12 character positions of the current record the sender. The receiver gets 'AB' followed by ten spaces while the record area holds ABCDEFGHIJKL. Arms a) and b) hold for records without an OCCURS DEPENDING ON table, so the verdict is PARTIAL. Cause, from the code-location: CurrentRecordImage windows RecordAreaImage(area), which for a variable-occurrence group is the group's image at its current ODO extent, and pads past it instead of reading the record area. §1985:VI.5.8.4 GR2 (contents beyond the ODO count are undefined) does not excuse this: the record area is shared (VII.4.4.4 GR6), and the PIC X(15) description defines those positions. kb/Work PB5309 holds the defect (code read: held-85/set1/decisions.json).

next.reason: 1985: "b. If data-name-1 is not specified, by the value that would have been moved into the data item referenced by data-name-1"; 2023: "If the number of bytes determined as above is zero, the record is a zero-length item.". Conditions a and b match; bytes vs character positions is terminology. 2023 adds a case 1985 lacks: a size of zero makes the sending record a zero-length item.
